title: Visit to the Alpujarras
text:
Wonderful day with a great guide. 
We wanted to visit the Alpujarras and taste their typical products. In this case we were lucky to have José who made us a driver and guide. In addition to driving wonderfully along those winding roads where it was hard not to get dizzy, he taught us the looms, the chocolate factory, a ham dryer and the nice, quiet streets of his villages, telling us lots of things about the area. All this at the pace we wanted, without hurry and being able to stop at the places we wanted to take photos, contemplate the landscape or rest. 
We would certainly repeat.
author: MONICA_D

title: Fantasic trip to the Alpujarra
text: The drive through the alpujarra was spectatcular.  The visit to the ham drying factrory was intersting and the ham tasting delicious. Carlor our guide was informative and added extra bits of information through out the trip. I enjoyed it very much.  The villages are unique and the countryside beautiful.  Nice minibus and a well run trip.
author: Janet_S

title: Amazing views
text: Views are amazing and Francisco our guide was the best. He explains very well and does not rush us.  Worth it 100%
author: Linda_R
